name: Zoom
desc: Hold a key to zoom in.

settings.name: Zoom Key
settings.desc: The key that zooms the camera in.

settings.name: Mode
settings.desc: Hold the key to zoom, or tap it to zoom in and tap again to zoom out.

settings.name: Zoom Level
settings.desc: How far a zoom starts in (4 = four times closer).

settings.name: Max Zoom
settings.desc: The furthest you can zoom in, scrolling included.

settings.name: Scroll To Zoom
settings.desc: Scroll while zoomed to zoom further in or out.

settings.name: Scroll Step %
settings.desc: How much one scroll notch zooms in or out.

settings.name: Remember Scroll Level
settings.desc: Start the next zoom at the level you last scrolled to, instead of Zoom Level.

settings.name: Smooth Scroll
settings.desc: Ease between levels when you scroll, instead of jumping.

settings.name: Animation
settings.desc: How the zoom moves in and out: at once, easing out, at a steady pace, or with a slight overshoot.

settings.name: Animation Speed
settings.desc: How fast the zoom animation plays (1 = normal).

settings.name: Sensitivity Mode
settings.desc: Scaled: the mouse slows down the further you zoom. Fixed: one sensitivity while zoomed. Vanilla: unchanged.

settings.name: Sensitivity Strength %
settings.desc: Scaled: how strongly the mouse slows down as you zoom (100 = normal, 0 = not at all).

settings.name: Fixed Sensitivity %
settings.desc: Fixed: mouse sensitivity while zoomed.

settings.name: Zoom Sensitivity %
settings.desc: Scaled: mouse sensitivity while zoomed, on top of the automatic slowdown.

settings.name: Cinematic Camera
settings.desc: Turn on vanilla's smooth Cinematic Camera while zoomed.

settings.name: Hide Hand
settings.desc: Hide your hand and held item while zoomed.

settings.name: Hide HUD
settings.desc: Hide the HUD while zoomed, like pressing F1.

settings.name: Overlay
settings.desc: Darken the screen edges, or look through a spyglass scope (first person), while zoomed.

settings.name: Zoom Level Indicator
settings.desc: Show the zoom level for a moment when you scroll.

name: Freelook
desc: Look around without turning. Disabled on servers that forbid it.

settings.name: Freelook Key
settings.desc: The key that lets you look around your character without turning it.

settings.name: Mode
settings.desc: Hold the key to look around, or tap it to start and tap again to stop.

settings.name: Stay Active In Screens
settings.desc: Keep looking around while a menu such as chat or your inventory is open. Off: opening one ends freelook.

settings.name: Perspective
settings.desc: The view to switch to while freelooking; your own view comes back afterwards.

settings.name: Camera Distance
settings.desc: How far back the third-person camera sits while freelooking, in % of its normal distance. It still stops in front of walls.

settings.name: Sensitivity
settings.desc: How fast the camera turns compared with normal aiming.

settings.name: Invert Yaw
settings.desc: Moving the mouse right turns the camera left.

settings.name: Invert Pitch
settings.desc: Moving the mouse up tilts the camera down.

settings.name: Yaw Limit
settings.desc: How far left or right of where you face the camera can turn, in degrees. 180: all the way round.

settings.name: Return
settings.desc: When freelook ends, snap straight back to where you aim, or swing back smoothly.

settings.name: Return Time
settings.desc: How long the smooth return takes, in milliseconds.

settings.name: Blocked Servers
settings.desc: More servers to keep Freelook off on, e.g. example.net (subdomains included).

name: World Map
desc: Full-screen map of the ground you've explored, with your waypoints.

settings.name: Open Key
settings.desc: Opens and closes the World Map. J by default: M is Simple Voice Chat's Mute Microphone key.

settings.name: Height Shading
settings.desc: Shade slopes so hills stand out: Classic uses three steps like a vanilla map, Smooth one per block.

settings.name: Water Depth
settings.desc: Deeper water is drawn darker.

settings.name: Show Waypoints
settings.desc: Your waypoints (and any the server adds) on the map, with their names.

settings.name: Show Teammates
settings.desc: Team mates the server shares with Evade, as dots: only players already loaded near you, never anyone else.

settings.name: Save To Disk
settings.desc: Keep the explored map between sessions (config/evade/maps). Off keeps it only until you leave.

settings.name: Memory Limit
settings.desc: Most megabytes of map kept in memory; older areas are saved and reloaded when you look at them.

name: Replay
desc: Record the world in 3D: fly through it afterwards, make camera paths, render video.

settings.name: Record Every Session
settings.desc: Starts recording a 3D replay automatically every time you join a world or server.

settings.name: Save When Leaving
settings.desc: If a replay is recording when you leave, it is saved instead of thrown away.

settings.name: Start / Save Key
settings.desc: Press to start recording a replay, and again to save it. Unbound by default.

settings.name: Marker Key
settings.desc: Press while recording to drop a marker you can jump to in the replay. Unbound by default.

settings.name: Recording Indicator
settings.desc: Shows a small REC timer in the top-right corner while a replay is recording.

settings.name: Record Voice Chat
settings.desc: With Simple Voice Chat, records what nearby players say, played back from where they stood.

settings.name: Record My Voice
settings.desc: Also records your own microphone into the replay. Needs Record Voice Chat.

name: Clips
desc: Instant replay and auto-clips: in Evade Clips when it's installed, or straight to MP4.

settings.name: Save Clip Key
settings.desc: Press to save the last moments of gameplay as a clip.

settings.name: Recorder
settings.desc: Auto: uses the Evade Clips app whenever it's running (with sound), otherwise Evade's built-in recorder (video only, no sound). Or pick one yourself.

settings.name: Clip Length (s)
settings.desc: Built-in recorder only. Evade Clips uses the replay length set in the app.

settings.name: Clip FPS
settings.desc: Built-in recorder only. Evade Clips records at the frame rate set in the app.

settings.name: Quality
settings.desc: Built-in recorder only. Evade Clips records at the quality set in the app.

settings.name: Recording Dot
settings.desc: Shows that the built-in recorder is running, as "● REC" in the window title.

settings.name: Show Overlays In Clips
settings.desc: Lets Evade's recording dot, banners and pop-ups appear in built-in recordings. Off keeps them out of your clips.

settings.name: Auto Clip Kills
settings.desc: Saves a clip by itself when you kill a player. Kills close together become one clip.

settings.name: Auto Clip Pops
settings.desc: Saves a clip when a player you're fighting uses a Totem of Undying.

settings.name: Auto Clip Deaths
settings.desc: Saves a clip of the moments before you die.

settings.name: Auto Clip Wins
settings.desc: Clip games you win. Other end-of-game lines only drop a marker on Evade Clips' timeline.

settings.name: Auto Clip Advancements
settings.desc: Saves a clip when you earn an advancement.

settings.name: Seconds After
settings.desc: How long an auto clip keeps recording after the moment that triggered it.

settings.name: Open Clips App
settings.desc: Press to open the Evade Clips desktop app. Unbound by default.

settings.name: Start Evade Clips With Game
settings.desc: Starts the Evade Clips app in the tray when the game starts, so instant replay is ready. Ignored when Recorder is Built-in.

settings.name: App Port
settings.desc: Evade Clips' control port. Read from the app when it's installed; only used if it can't be.

name: Keystrokes
desc: Shows your movement keys, mouse and space presses.

settings.name: Mouse Buttons
settings.desc: Adds left and right mouse button keys under the movement keys.

settings.name: Show CPS
settings.desc: Shows your clicks per second on the mouse buttons.

settings.name: CPS Style
settings.desc: Where clicks per second show: small under LMB/RMB, instead of the labels, or in one row ("12 | 9 CPS") under the buttons. Combined Row also shows with Mouse Buttons off.

settings.name: Space Bar
settings.desc: Adds a jump key under the others.

settings.name: Space Bar Style
settings.desc: The space bar as a dash, or labelled with the key jump is bound to.

settings.name: Sneak Key
settings.desc: A sneak key, lit while you hold it, and while the game's own Sneak: Toggle keeps you sneaking.

settings.name: Sprint Key
settings.desc: A sprint key, lit while you hold it, and while the game's own Sprint: Toggle keeps you sprinting.

settings.name: Key Labels
settings.desc: Label the movement keys with the keys they're bound to (LShift, MMB, M4...), always W A S D, or arrows.

settings.name: Key Size
settings.desc: Width and height of a movement key, in pixels. The rows below scale with it.

settings.name: Gap
settings.desc: Space between keys, in pixels.

settings.name: Key Color
settings.desc: Background of a key. Reset to follow the widget's background style.

settings.name: Pressed Color
settings.desc: A key while pressed. Reset to follow the accent colour.

settings.name: Text Color
settings.desc: Key labels. Reset for the theme's text colour.

settings.name: Pressed Text Color
settings.desc: Key labels while pressed. Reset for the theme's text-on-accent colour.

settings.name: Text Shadow
settings.desc: Draws a dark drop shadow under the key labels.

settings.name: Press Animation
settings.desc: Fade lights a key at once and fades it out; Instant has no fade; Fill rises from the bottom of the key; Shrink presses the key in a little.

settings.name: Fade Time
settings.desc: Milliseconds a key takes to fade out after you let go. 0 turns it off at once.

settings.name: Mouse Movement
settings.desc: Adds a pad under the keys with a dot that follows how fast and which way you move the mouse while looking around.

settings.name: Scale
settings.desc: How big the widget is drawn. You can also scroll over it in the HUD editor to resize it.

settings.name: Background
settings.desc: Draws a panel behind the widget so it stays readable on bright scenes.

settings.name: Background Style
settings.desc: Look of the panel: Evade (soft rounded), Solid, Glass (frosted) or Outline (border only).

settings.name: Background Opacity
settings.desc: How see-through the panel is. Lower lets more of the game show through.

settings.name: Hide In Menus
settings.desc: Hides it while a menu or inventory is open. Chat doesn't count.

settings.name: Only In Combat
settings.desc: Shows it only during a fight: for 8 seconds after you hit something or take damage.

settings.name: Smooth Font
settings.desc: Draw this widget's text in Evade's smooth font instead of the pixel font.

name: Cooldowns
desc: Timers for pearls, wind charges, spears, gapples and more.

settings.name: Style
settings.desc: Rows: icon, name, time and a bar. Compact: icon, time and a bar. Icons: a strip of icons with the time under each.

settings.name: Width
settings.desc: Width of the panel in the Rows style.

settings.name: Time Format
settings.desc: Decimal (12.5s), Whole seconds (13s), Clock (0:13) or game ticks (250t).

settings.name: Sort
settings.desc: Time Left puts what's ready soonest on top, Longest First the opposite, Fixed keeps a set order. READY always goes last.

settings.name: Bar Color
settings.desc: Per Type gives each kind of cooldown and effect its own colour, Accent uses the theme colour, Fade goes from red to green as it runs out.

settings.name: Weapon Charge
settings.desc: Shows your held weapon's attack charge as a row while it refills after a swing.

settings.name: Effect Timers
settings.desc: Timers for effects: the PvP set (gapple, regeneration, strength, speed, fire resistance, resistance), every good effect, every effect, or none. Hidden while Potion Effects is on, which already shows them.

settings.name: Show Amplifier
settings.desc: Add the effect's level to its name, e.g. Strength II.

settings.name: Expiring Warning
settings.desc: Effects with this many seconds or fewer left blink red. 0 turns it off.

settings.name: Ready Flash
settings.desc: Shows the item with READY for a moment when its cooldown ends.

settings.name: Ready Flash Time
settings.desc: Seconds READY stays up after something comes off cooldown.

settings.name: Ready Sound
settings.desc: Sound played when something comes off cooldown.

settings.name: Sound Volume
settings.desc: How loud the Ready Sound plays, in percent.

settings.name: Alert For
settings.desc: Which cooldowns play the ready sound: all of them, only what's in your hands, or only ender pearls and wind charges.

settings.name: Min Alert Length
settings.desc: Cooldowns shorter than this many seconds never play the sound or flash READY.

settings.name: Hotbar Timer
settings.desc: Write the time left on hotbar items while they're on cooldown.

settings.name: Hotbar Timer Color
settings.desc: Colour of the time written on hotbar items, with Hotbar Timer on.

settings.name: Scale
settings.desc: How big the widget is drawn. You can also scroll over it in the HUD editor to resize it.

settings.name: Background
settings.desc: Draws a panel behind the widget so it stays readable on bright scenes.

settings.name: Background Style
settings.desc: Look of the panel: Evade (soft rounded), Solid, Glass (frosted) or Outline (border only).

settings.name: Background Opacity
settings.desc: How see-through the panel is. Lower lets more of the game show through.

settings.name: Hide In Menus
settings.desc: Hides it while a menu or inventory is open. Chat doesn't count.

settings.name: Only In Combat
settings.desc: Shows it only during a fight: for 8 seconds after you hit something or take damage.

settings.name: Smooth Font
settings.desc: Draw this widget's text in Evade's smooth font instead of the pixel font.

name: Crosshair
desc: Custom crosshair.

settings.name: Style
settings.desc: The crosshair's shape. Custom uses the pixels you draw in the editor (Pattern).

settings.name: Color Mode
settings.desc: Static uses Color. Invert flips what's behind it like the vanilla crosshair (always readable, no outline). Chroma cycles through the rainbow.

settings.name: Color
settings.desc: The crosshair's colour while Color Mode is Static.

settings.name: Chroma Speed
settings.desc: How fast Chroma cycles: 1 goes round the rainbow every 4 seconds.

settings.name: Target Color
settings.desc: The crosshair's colour while you aim at a mob or player, with Highlight Targets on.

settings.name: Highlight Targets
settings.desc: Use Target Color while you aim at a mob or player (not with Invert).

settings.name: Opacity
settings.desc: How solid the crosshair, its outline and the Bar or Ring indicator are.

settings.name: Size
settings.desc: Arm length, or the radius of Circle and Square.

settings.name: Gap
settings.desc: Empty pixels between the centre and the arms.

settings.name: Thickness
settings.desc: Width of the arms and of the Square's border.

settings.name: Dot Size
settings.desc: The dot of Dot, Cross + Dot and Circle + Dot: 1 is a single pixel, each step adds a pixel all round.

settings.name: Circle Thickness
settings.desc: Width of the ring of Circle and Circle + Dot.

settings.name: Rotation
settings.desc: Turns the crosshair clockwise around its centre (45 makes a Cross an X).

settings.name: Outline
settings.desc: A dark edge around the crosshair so it stays visible on bright backgrounds.

settings.name: Outline Color
settings.desc: Colour of the Outline drawn around the crosshair.

settings.name: Outline Thickness
settings.desc: How many pixels the Outline is wide (only while Outline is on).

settings.name: Dynamic Gap
settings.desc: Opens the crosshair while you draw a bow or crossbow (closing as it charges) or while you move.

settings.name: Dynamic Strength
settings.desc: The most pixels Dynamic Gap adds.

settings.name: Dynamic Smoothing
settings.desc: How quickly Dynamic Gap follows: higher is snappier.

settings.name: Attack Indicator
settings.desc: Your attack cooldown under the crosshair. Follow Vanilla shows vanilla's when Video Settings' Attack Indicator is Crosshair.

settings.name: Indicator Color
settings.desc: Colour of the Bar or Ring attack cooldown indicator.

settings.name: Indicator Width
settings.desc: Length of the Bar indicator.

settings.name: Indicator Offset
settings.desc: How far below the centre the indicator sits; the Ring's radius.

settings.name: Show In 3rd Person
settings.desc: Also draws the crosshair in third-person view, where the game normally hides it.

settings.name: Hit Marker
settings.desc: A small X flashes around the crosshair when the server confirms a hit you landed (melee or projectile).

settings.name: Hit Marker Color
settings.desc: Colour of the Hit Marker.

settings.name: Hit Marker Time
settings.desc: Seconds the hit marker stays before fading out.

name: Waypoints
desc: Saved locations with beams and distance.

settings.name: Death Points
settings.desc: Save a point where you die.

settings.name: Keep Deaths
settings.desc: How many of your latest deaths are kept in each world: the newest is Death, then Death 2, Death 3...

settings.name: Death Message
settings.desc: Say in chat where you died once you respawn.

settings.name: Clear Death On Arrival
settings.desc: Remove a death point once you walk back to it (within Arrival Distance).

settings.name: Expire After
settings.desc: Remove death points this many minutes after you died. 0 keeps them.

settings.name: Default Color
settings.desc: Colour of points that don't have their own (set one with .wp color).

settings.name: Death Color
settings.desc: Colour of death points.

settings.name: Random Colors
settings.desc: Give each new point its own colour, different from the points you already have.

settings.name: Quick Add Key
settings.desc: Save a point where you stand (Waypoint 1, Waypoint 2, ...).

settings.name: Label
settings.desc: What each point's label shows.

settings.name: Show Coordinates
settings.desc: Add each point's coordinates to its label (not where the server hides coordinates).

settings.name: Y Difference
settings.desc: Add how many blocks above or below you each point is.

settings.name: Label Scale
settings.desc: Size of the labels.

settings.name: Details On Look
settings.desc: Labels show just the name until you look towards the point.

settings.name: Look Angle
settings.desc: How close to a point you must look, in degrees, to see its details.

settings.name: Outline Box
settings.desc: Outline the block each point is on.

settings.name: Fill Opacity
settings.desc: Fill the point's block with its colour, in percent. 0 leaves it clear.

settings.name: Line Width
settings.desc: Thickness of the outline and of line beams.

settings.name: Beams
settings.desc: A beam rising from each point, so you can find it from far away.

settings.name: Beam Style
settings.desc: A thin line, or a see-through pillar.

settings.name: Beam Height
settings.desc: How tall beams are, in blocks. 0 reaches the build limit.

settings.name: Other Dimension
settings.desc: Show Overworld points in the Nether at the matching spot (divided by 8), and Nether points in the Overworld (times 8).

settings.name: Hide Within
settings.desc: Hide points closer than this many blocks (your target always shows). 0 shows them all.

settings.name: Max Distance
settings.desc: Hide points further away than this many blocks (your target always shows). 0 shows them at any distance.

settings.name: Off-Screen Arrows
settings.desc: Arrows around the crosshair pointing to points that are off screen: your target only, or all of them.

settings.name: Arrow Radius
settings.desc: How far from the crosshair the arrows sit.

settings.name: Direction HUD Markers
settings.desc: Mark your points on the Direction HUD's compass strip.

settings.name: Arrival Distance
settings.desc: How close counts as arriving: at your target (which then clears) and at a death point.

name: Performance
desc: Built-in FPS boost: culling, lighter rendering and an idle frame cap.

settings.name: Entity Culling
settings.desc: Skips drawing mobs and other entities farther away than Entity Distance. Bosses, holograms, map art, glowing and name-tagged entities always show.

settings.name: Entity Distance
settings.desc: How far away entities are still drawn while Entity Culling is on, in blocks.

settings.name: Item Distance
settings.desc: Dropped items farther away than this aren't drawn.

settings.name: Decoration Distance
settings.desc: Item frames, paintings, armor stands and display blocks farther away than this aren't drawn. Map art, holograms and named stands always are.

settings.name: Cull Projectiles & XP
settings.desc: Also skip far arrows, tridents, thrown items and experience orbs. Your own are always drawn. Off: the game decides, as usual.

settings.name: Projectile & XP Distance
settings.desc: How far projectiles and experience orbs are drawn while Cull Projectiles & XP is on.

settings.name: Always Show Players
settings.desc: Other players are drawn as far as the game normally draws them, whatever Entity Distance says.

settings.name: Block Entity Culling
settings.desc: Skips drawing chests, signs, banners, beds and similar blocks farther away than Block Entity Distance.

settings.name: Block Entity Distance
settings.desc: How far away chests, signs and other block entities are still drawn, in blocks. Never past the game's own 64.

settings.name: Render One Item Per Stack
settings.desc: A dropped stack of items is drawn as a single item instead of a small pile.

settings.name: Particles Kept %
settings.desc: Share of particles still drawn; the rest are skipped. Lower helps FPS where there are lots of them.

settings.name: Particle Distance
settings.desc: Particles farther away than this are skipped. Fishing bites, splashes, explosions and fireworks always show.

settings.name: Max Particles
settings.desc: A hard limit on live particles: past it new ones are skipped until some fade. Fishing bites, splashes and fireworks always show.

settings.name: Hide Ambient Particles
settings.desc: Hides decorative particles that tell you nothing: campfire smoke, ash, spores, falling leaves, water drips and fireflies.

settings.name: Hide Lava Drips
settings.desc: Also hides lava dripping through ceilings. Off by default, because drips warn you there is lava above.

settings.name: Less Block Break Dust
settings.desc: Draws only a quarter of the dust that flies off a block while you break it.

settings.name: Hide Rain Splashes
settings.desc: Hides the small splashes raindrops make on the ground.

settings.name: Hide Fire On Mobs
settings.desc: Burning mobs skip their fire layer. Players on fire still show it.

settings.name: Hide Rain & Snow
settings.desc: Stops drawing falling rain and snow. The weather itself and its sounds are unchanged.

settings.name: Low FPS When Tabbed Out
settings.desc: Lowers the frame rate while another window has focus, so your PC runs cooler. Only while the game's "Reduce FPS when" is AFK (its default).

settings.name: Tabbed Out FPS
settings.desc: Frame rate used while Low FPS When Tabbed Out is on and the game isn't the focused window.

settings.name: Minimised FPS
settings.desc: Frame rate while the game is minimised (the game's own is 10). Used as set outside a world (title screen, server list); in a world it never goes below 4, so the game keeps all 20 ticks a second.

settings.name: Volume When Tabbed Out %
settings.desc: Turns every sound down while the game isn't the focused window. Your volume settings are never changed.

settings.name: Low FPS When AFK
settings.desc: Lowers the frame rate after a while with no mouse or keyboard input; any input brings full speed back. Only while the game's "Reduce FPS when" is AFK.

settings.name: AFK After (s)
settings.desc: Seconds without any input before Low FPS When AFK kicks in.

settings.name: AFK FPS
settings.desc: Frame rate used while you are AFK. Only ever lowers the game's own cap.

settings.name: Adaptive Quality
settings.desc: While the frame rate is under Target FPS, thin particles first, then draw entities and block entities less far. Everything comes back once it recovers.

settings.name: Target FPS
settings.desc: The frame rate Adaptive Quality aims for. Never above your Max Framerate or, with VSync, your monitor's refresh rate.

settings.name: Adapt Speed
settings.desc: How quickly Adaptive Quality reacts to the frame rate.

settings.name: FPS Mode
settings.desc: Max FPS: the highest frame rate, render distance up to 8. Balanced: big gains while it still looks good, render distance up to 12. Quality: unlocks the frame rate, keeps your visuals and sharpens distant textures. Custom: set everything yourself.

settings.name: Unlock FPS
settings.desc: Turns VSync off and removes the frame rate cap, so the game runs as fast as your PC allows. Turn off to put your own VSync and Max Framerate back.

settings.name: Render Distance Cap
settings.desc: Lowers your render distance to this while Performance is on (0 = leave it alone). Far chunks cost the most frames, especially on laptop graphics.

settings.name: Render Scale %
settings.desc: Draws the 3D world at this share of your screen's resolution and scales it up, while the HUD, chat, menus and text stay sharp at full resolution. The biggest FPS win on laptop graphics: 70% draws half the pixels. 100 = off. Paused automatically while a shader pack is on, since shaders draw at their own resolution.

settings.name: Sharpen
settings.desc: A light sharpening pass on the scaled-up world that wins back detail without halos. Costs next to nothing. Only used below 100%.

settings.name: Shaders
settings.desc: Switch shaders without opening Iris. Evade Shaders is Evade's own pack, free and fast on laptops (pick Potato to Ultra in its settings); Photon looks the best; Complementary is lighter. Shaders cost a lot of FPS, so they're best left Off for the highest frame rates.

settings.name: Lighter Video Settings
settings.desc: Clouds and entity shadows off, fewer particles, a smaller rain and snow area, shorter cloud distance and Improved Transparency off. Your own values come back when you turn this off.

settings.name: Low-End PC Mode
settings.desc: Also solid leaves, no smooth lighting, no chunk fade-in, no biome blending, no vignette, plain texture filtering and the smallest rain and snow area. Your own values come back when you turn this off.

settings.name: Sharper Distant Textures
settings.desc: Turns on anisotropic texture filtering when yours is off, so floors and walls stay crisp at a distance. Costs very little on most graphics cards. Ignored while Low-End PC Mode is on.

settings.name: Borderless Fullscreen
settings.desc: Fills the screen with a frameless window instead of the game's own fullscreen: instant Alt-Tab and no flicker on a second monitor. While F11 fullscreen is on, that one is used.

settings.name: Tune Sodium Too
settings.desc: FPS Mode also sets Sodium and Sodium Extra when they're installed: Max FPS turns off water, lava, fire and portal animations and the stars, and defers chunk updates; Max FPS and Balanced size Sodium's chunk build threads to your processor. Your own Sodium settings come back when you turn this off.

settings.name: HUD Refresh
settings.desc: How often Evade's HUD widgets are redrawn. Between redraws the last drawing is reused, and a widget whose text changes is redrawn at once. Auto: 60 times a second while the game runs above 90 FPS, every frame below that. Moving widgets (minimap, graphs, keystrokes while a key lights up) are drawn every frame.

settings.name: Battery FPS Cap
settings.desc: While your laptop runs on battery, the frame rate is held at this, for a longer battery life and a cooler laptop. Plugged in, nothing changes.

settings.name: Smooth Pacing
settings.desc: Caps the frame rate 3 below your monitor's refresh rate and spaces frames evenly, for steadier motion without VSync's input delay. Only used while VSync is off.

name: Action Bar
desc: Move and resize the action bar message above the hotbar.

settings.name: Scale
settings.desc: How big the widget is drawn. You can also scroll over it in the HUD editor to resize it.

settings.name: Background
settings.desc: Draws a panel behind the widget so it stays readable on bright scenes.

settings.name: Background Style
settings.desc: Look of the panel: Evade (soft rounded), Solid, Glass (frosted) or Outline (border only).

settings.name: Background Opacity
settings.desc: How see-through the panel is. Lower lets more of the game show through.

settings.name: Hide In Menus
settings.desc: Hides it while a menu or inventory is open. Chat doesn't count.

settings.name: Only In Combat
settings.desc: Shows it only during a fight: for 8 seconds after you hit something or take damage.

settings.name: Smooth Font
settings.desc: Draw this widget's text in Evade's smooth font instead of the pixel font.

name: ArmorHUD
desc: Shows your armour durability and supplies.

settings.name: Layout
settings.desc: Line the items up side by side or in a column.

settings.name: Order
settings.desc: Which end of your armour comes first: the helmet or the boots.

settings.name: Durability Text
settings.desc: The label on each item that can wear out: percent left, durability left, durability left out of the total, or none.

settings.name: Durability Color
settings.desc: Gradient fades from green to red. Thresholds: green, yellow under half, red under Warn Below %. Static uses Static Color.

settings.name: Static Color
settings.desc: Colour of the durability text when Durability Color is Static.

settings.name: Text Side
settings.desc: Vertical layout: durability text under each item or beside it. Auto puts it on the side facing the middle of the screen.

settings.name: Hands
settings.desc: Also shows the items in your main hand and off hand.

settings.name: Held Total
settings.desc: For stackable held items, show how many you carry in total instead of the stack in your hand.
