settings.desc: Auto lines text up with the screen edge the widget is anchored to, so changing numbers don't jitter.

settings.name: Label/Value Colors
settings.desc: In lines like "Ping: 42 ms", draw the label in Text Color and the value in Value Color.

settings.name: Value Color
settings.desc: Colour of the value after the label, with Label/Value Colors on.

settings.name: Scale
settings.desc: How big the widget is drawn. You can also scroll over it in the HUD editor to resize it.

settings.name: Background
settings.desc: Draws a panel behind the widget so it stays readable on bright scenes.

settings.name: Background Style
settings.desc: Look of the panel: Evade (soft rounded), Solid, Glass (frosted) or Outline (border only).

settings.name: Background Opacity
settings.desc: How see-through the panel is. Lower lets more of the game show through.

settings.name: Hide In Menus
settings.desc: Hides it while a menu or inventory is open. Chat doesn't count.

settings.name: Only In Combat
settings.desc: Shows it only during a fight: for 8 seconds after you hit something or take damage.

settings.name: Smooth Font
settings.desc: Draw this widget's text in Evade's smooth font instead of the pixel font.

name: Watermark
desc: The Evade logo or your own text in the corner, with FPS and ping if you like.

settings.name: Watermark Style
settings.desc: The Evade logo, your own text, or the logo with FPS, ping or the time beside it.

settings.name: Watermark Text
settings.desc: What the Text style shows; its first letter takes the accent colour. Placeholders like {fps} or {time:HH:mm} and colour tags like <red> work here too.

settings.name: Watermark Info
settings.desc: What Logo + Info and Text show after the name.

settings.name: Watermark Size
settings.desc: Height of the logo; the text and info scale with it.

settings.name: Scale
settings.desc: How big the widget is drawn. You can also scroll over it in the HUD editor to resize it.

settings.name: Background
settings.desc: Draws a panel behind the widget so it stays readable on bright scenes.

settings.name: Background Style
settings.desc: Look of the panel: Evade (soft rounded), Solid, Glass (frosted) or Outline (border only).

settings.name: Background Opacity
settings.desc: How see-through the panel is. Lower lets more of the game show through.

settings.name: Hide In Menus
settings.desc: Hides it while a menu or inventory is open. Chat doesn't count.

settings.name: Only In Combat
settings.desc: Shows it only during a fight: for 8 seconds after you hit something or take damage.

settings.name: Smooth Font
settings.desc: Draw this widget's text in Evade's smooth font instead of the pixel font.

name: 1.7 Animations
desc: Visual 1.7 animations: swing while eating, sword block, item poses, red armour.

settings.name: Swing While Eating
settings.desc: Clicking while you eat, drink or block swings your hand on your screen, like 1.7. Nothing is sent to the server.

settings.name: 1.7 Item Position
settings.desc: Holds items lower in first person, like older versions.

settings.name: Item Lowered By
settings.desc: How far 1.7 Item Position lowers held items, in blocks.

settings.name: 1.7 Sword Block
settings.desc: With a sword in your main hand and a shield in your off hand, blocking shows the old sword-block pose instead of the shield. The shield still blocks as normal.

settings.name: 1.7 Rod
settings.desc: Holds fishing rods (and sticks with carrots or fungus) the other way round, like 1.7.

settings.name: 1.7 Bow
settings.desc: Tilts the bow toward the middle of the screen while you draw it, like 1.7.

settings.name: Red Armour
settings.desc: Armour flashes red along with the player or mob wearing it when they're hurt, like 1.7.

settings.name: 1.7 Hurt Tilt
settings.desc: Your view always shakes the same way when you're hurt, like 1.7, instead of away from the hit.

settings.name: 1.7 Sneak Camera
settings.desc: Your view drops straight down when you sneak instead of gliding. Camera only: your real eye height is the server's.

settings.name: 1.7 Health Flash
settings.desc: Your hearts flash only right after you take damage, with 1.7's timing, not when you heal.

name: BetterTooltips
desc: Container previews, durability, food and more in item tooltips.

settings.name: Shulker Display
settings.desc: How shulker boxes and other filled containers show what's inside: a slot grid, a totalled list, one icon per item kind, or nothing extra.

settings.name: Tint By Box Colour
settings.desc: Colours a shulker box's grid like the box itself.

settings.name: Hide Vanilla Summary
settings.desc: Leaves out the game's short "and 3 more..." list, so contents aren't shown twice.

settings.name: Hold Shift To Expand
settings.desc: Shows the compact row of item kinds until you hold Shift, then the full grid or list.

settings.name: List Sort
settings.desc: Order of the List and Compact views: most first, alphabetical, or as they sit in the container.

settings.name: Max List Lines
settings.desc: Most item kinds the List view shows; the rest are counted as "+N more".

settings.name: Ender Chest Preview
settings.desc: Ender chest items show what your ender chest held the last time you opened it on this server or world (a grid when Shulker Display is Off). Remembered until you close the game.

settings.name: Durability
settings.desc: Shows uses left on tools and armour.

settings.name: Only When Damaged
settings.desc: Leaves the durability line off items that haven't been used yet.

settings.name: Unbreaking Estimate
settings.desc: On Unbreaking items, adds about how many uses are really left (Unbreaking skips some of the wear).

settings.name: Low Warning %
settings.desc: Below this much durability the line turns bold red with a warning. 0 turns the warning off.

settings.name: Food Display
settings.desc: Shows the hunger a food restores as text, as hunger-bar shanks, or not at all.

settings.name: Show Saturation
settings.desc: Adds the saturation a food gives (how long before hunger starts dropping again).

settings.name: Show Effects
settings.desc: Lists the effects eating or drinking something gives, with duration and chance (golden apples, pufferfish, honey, milk...).

settings.name: Anvil Cost
settings.desc: Shows the extra levels earlier anvil work adds to the next repair; red once the anvil would call it too expensive.

settings.name: Fuel Time
settings.desc: Shows how many items a fuel smelts in a furnace, and for how long it burns.

settings.name: Map Preview
settings.desc: Filled maps show their picture, for maps your game already has (ones you've held or seen in an item frame).

settings.name: Map Preview Size
settings.desc: How big the map picture is, in GUI pixels.

settings.name: Book Preview
settings.desc: Written books and books and quills show their first page and how many pages they have.

settings.name: Banner Preview
settings.desc: Banners show a large flag with all their patterns; banner pattern items show their pattern on a white banner.

settings.name: Details Need Shift
settings.desc: Hides the extra lines (durability, food, anvil, fuel) until you hold Shift. Container previews always show.

name: Boss Bar
desc: Shrink, move, trim or hide the boss health bars.

settings.name: Hide
settings.desc: Hides boss bars completely.

settings.name: Scale
settings.desc: How big the boss bars are drawn (1 = vanilla size).

settings.name: Y Offset
settings.desc: Move the boss bars down from the top of the screen.

settings.name: Max Bars
settings.desc: The most boss bars shown at once. Vanilla also stops at a third of the screen.

settings.name: Mode
settings.desc: Show each bar with the boss's name, just the bar, or just the name.

name: Camera Distance
desc: Set your third-person camera distance.

settings.name: Distance
settings.desc: Blocks behind you at normal size; 4 is the vanilla distance.

settings.name: Front Distance
settings.desc: Blocks in front of you in the front view (press F5 twice).

settings.name: Follow Player Scale
settings.desc: Grow and shrink the distance with your size and your mount's, like vanilla (a big mount pulls the camera further back).

settings.name: Wall Mode
settings.desc: Collide stops the camera in front of blocks, like vanilla. Clip lets it pass through blocks, but only in spectator mode; everywhere else it collides.

settings.name: Smooth Camera
settings.desc: Ease the camera to a new distance instead of jumping. It still snaps in at once when a wall gets in the way.

settings.name: Smoothing Speed
settings.desc: How quickly the smooth camera catches up; higher is snappier.

settings.name: Scroll To Adjust
settings.desc: Scroll the mouse wheel in third person to move the camera closer or further. Off keeps hotbar scrolling as normal.

settings.name: Scroll Key
settings.desc: Only adjust the distance while this key is held, so scrolling still changes your hotbar slot otherwise. None: always adjust in third person.

settings.name: Scroll Step
settings.desc: Blocks the camera moves per scroll notch.

settings.name: Shoulder Offset
settings.desc: Shift the back view sideways for an over-the-shoulder camera: positive right, negative left. Your aim does not move, so a third-person crosshair no longer lines up exactly with what you hit.

settings.name: Height Offset
settings.desc: Raise or lower the back view. It stops at ceilings and floors.

settings.name: Swap Shoulder Key
settings.desc: Press to move the camera to your other shoulder.

name: Chunk Borders
desc: Shows chunk boundaries on a single key.

settings.name: Color
settings.desc: Colour of the chunk border lines.

settings.name: Height
settings.desc: How many blocks above and below you the grid reaches.

settings.name: Section Lines
settings.desc: Brighter rings every 16 blocks of height, where the world's sections meet.

settings.name: Through Walls
settings.desc: Draw the grid over blocks. Off: blocks in front of a line hide it.

name: Clear Water
desc: Removes underwater fog. Blindness and Darkness still apply.

settings.name: Hide Water Overlay
settings.desc: Also removes the blue tint drawn over the screen while you're underwater.

name: Cosmetics
desc: Evade capes, wings, hats, pets, emotes and effects, seen only by other Evade players.

settings.name: Show My Cosmetics
settings.desc: Show your own cosmetics in third person, in your inventory and in the Wardrobe.

settings.name: Show Others' Cosmetics
settings.desc: Show the cosmetics other Evade players near you are wearing.

settings.name: Hide In Combat
settings.desc: Hide every cosmetic for a few seconds after you hit something or take damage.

settings.name: Particle Amount
settings.desc: How many particles auras, trails and effects make, in %. 0 turns cosmetic particles off.

settings.name: Render Distance
settings.desc: How far away, in blocks, other players' cosmetics are still drawn.

settings.name: Emote Wheel Key
settings.desc: Opens the emote wheel. Moving, attacking or taking damage ends an emote.

name: Damage Numbers
desc: Floating numbers or hit markers on things you hit, once the server confirms the hit.

settings.name: Show
settings.desc: Your Damage: your swing's damage before armour. Hit Marker: just a mark where each confirmed hit landed.

settings.name: Duration
settings.desc: Seconds each number stays up while it floats away.

settings.name: Size
settings.desc: How big the numbers are drawn.

settings.name: Color
settings.desc: Colour of normal damage numbers.

settings.name: Crit Color
settings.desc: Colour of damage numbers from critical hits.

settings.name: Text Shadow
settings.desc: Draws a dark drop shadow under the numbers.

settings.name: Distance Scaling
settings.desc: Numbers further away are drawn smaller.

name: Damage Tint
desc: A red screen vignette when your health gets low.

settings.name: Hearts
settings.desc: The tint starts once your health drops below this many hearts, and gets stronger as it falls.

settings.name: Strength %
settings.desc: How strong the tint is at its strongest, when your health is almost gone.

settings.name: Color
settings.desc: Colour of the tint around the screen edges.

name: EnchantGlint
desc: Restyle the enchantment glow: colour, gradient or rainbow, brightness, speed and size.

settings.name: Style
settings.desc: Solid: one colour. Gradient: Color blending into Second Color across the glint. Rainbow: every colour, slowly cycling.

settings.name: Color
settings.desc: Glint colour on items: in your hand, in inventories and on the ground (Solid and Gradient).

settings.name: Second Color
settings.desc: The other end of the Gradient style.

settings.name: Rainbow Saturation %
settings.desc: How vivid the Rainbow style's colours are: lower is more pastel.

settings.name: Intensity %
settings.desc: Brightness of the glint's sheen (100 = as bright as the original).

settings.name: Armor Glint
settings.desc: Glint on worn armour: the same style as items, Armor Color, the game's own purple, or none at all.

settings.name: Armor Color
settings.desc: Glint colour on armour worn by you and other players and mobs (Armor Glint: Custom).

settings.name: Speed
settings.desc: How fast the glint pattern scrolls, on top of the game's Glint Speed option (0 = still).

settings.name: Scale
settings.desc: Size of the glint pattern (1 = vanilla, higher = bigger streaks).

name: Fullbright
desc: Lights up caves and night. Leaves your Brightness setting alone.

settings.name: Mode
settings.desc: Gamma: brightens dark places but keeps light and shadow. Night Vision: lights the world like the potion, without the effect. Full Light: every block fully lit, no shading.

settings.name: Strength %
settings.desc: How much brighter dark places get. 100 lights everything fully.

settings.name: Adaptive
settings.desc: Only brighten where it's dark: full strength at or below Full Boost Below Light, fading out towards full light (bright daylight or a torch at your feet).

settings.name: Full Boost Below Light
settings.desc: Adaptive: the light level (0-15) at or below which Fullbright works at full strength.

settings.name: Fade Time
settings.desc: Seconds to fade in or out when switched, or when Adaptive follows the light. 0 is instant.

name: Hit Color
desc: Customise the flash colour when you hit players or mobs.

settings.name: Color
settings.desc: The colour mobs and players flash when they take damage (vanilla is red).

settings.name: Opacity %
settings.desc: How much of the entity's own colours shows through the flash: lower is a stronger tint.

settings.name: Animation
settings.desc: Static: the full flash for as long as the entity is hurt. Fade Out: it fades away over the hurt time.

settings.name: On Death
settings.desc: The flash while a mob or player dies: kept, faded out over the death animation, or none.

settings.name: Separate Player Color
settings.desc: Players flash in Player Color, mobs in Color.

settings.name: Player Color
settings.desc: The flash colour for players, with Separate Player Color on.

settings.name: Tint Self
settings.desc: Your own player flashes too (third person). Off: you never do.

settings.name: Chroma
settings.desc: The flash cycles through every colour (players half a cycle apart with Separate Player Color).

settings.name: Chroma Speed
settings.desc: How fast Chroma cycles: 1 is one full cycle every 4 seconds.

name: Hitboxes
desc: Colour, line width and filters for the F3+B hitbox view.

settings.name: Box Color
settings.desc: Colour of the hitbox outline.

settings.name: Line Width
settings.desc: Thickness of the hitbox lines. The game's own is 2.5.

settings.name: Eye Line
settings.desc: The line at eye height on players and mobs.

settings.name: Eye Line Color
settings.desc: Colour of the eye-height line.

settings.name: Look Vector
settings.desc: The arrow showing where each entity is looking.

settings.name: Players
settings.desc: Show hitboxes of players.

settings.name: Items
settings.desc: Show hitboxes of dropped items.

settings.name: Projectiles
settings.desc: Show hitboxes of arrows, tridents, snowballs, pearls and other projectiles.

settings.name: Other Entities
settings.desc: Show hitboxes of mobs, animals, vehicles, item frames and everything else.

name: Inventory Blur
desc: Blurs the background behind open inventories.

settings.name: Strength
settings.desc: How blurry the world behind gets, on the same scale as the game's Menu Background Blur (which goes to 10).

settings.name: Dim %
settings.desc: How much the world behind darkens. 80 looks like vanilla; 0 leaves only the blur.

settings.name: Tint
settings.desc: The colour the background darkens toward.

settings.name: Fade In
settings.desc: Milliseconds the blur and dim take to fade in when a screen opens. 0 = instant.

settings.name: Player Inventory
settings.desc: Your own inventory, survival and creative.

settings.name: Storage
settings.desc: Chests, barrels, shulker boxes, hoppers, dispensers, droppers and mount inventories.

settings.name: Workstations
settings.desc: Crafting tables, furnaces, anvils, enchanting tables, brewing stands, smithing tables, looms, stonecutters, grindstones, cartography tables, villagers, beacons and crafters.

settings.name: Books & Signs
settings.desc: Reading and writing books, lecterns and editing signs.

name: Item Highlight
desc: Highlights slots holding the items you choose in open inventories and chests.

settings.name: Items
settings.desc: The items whose slots are highlighted. Click to pick them from a searchable grid.

settings.name: Color
settings.desc: Colour of the highlight (its transparency too).

settings.name: Style
settings.desc: Fill the slot behind the item, outline it, or both.

name: Item Physics
desc: Dropped items tumble, land flat and float in water instead of spinning in place.

settings.name: Mode
settings.desc: Physics: items tumble through the air and tip over flat when they land. Flat: they just lie on the ground.

settings.name: Spin Speed
settings.desc: How fast items tumble while they fly (Physics).

settings.name: Float In Water
settings.desc: Items in water bob and sway gently instead of lying still.

settings.name: Item Size
settings.desc: Size of dropped items (1 = vanilla).

settings.name: Random Rotation
settings.desc: Each item lies at its own angle. Off: they all line up.

name: Item View
desc: Position, rotation and size of held items per hand, swing speed and shield.

settings.name: Main Hand X
settings.desc: Moves the item in your main hand left (negative) or right, in blocks.

settings.name: Main Hand Y
settings.desc: Moves the item in your main hand down (negative) or up, in blocks.

settings.name: Main Hand Z
settings.desc: Moves the item in your main hand closer (positive) or further away, in blocks.

settings.name: Main Hand Tilt
settings.desc: Tips the item in your main hand forward or back, in degrees.

settings.name: Main Hand Turn
settings.desc: Turns the item in your main hand left or right, in degrees.

settings.name: Main Hand Roll
settings.desc: Rolls the item in your main hand sideways, in degrees.

settings.name: Main Hand Size %
settings.desc: How big the item in your main hand is drawn.

settings.name: Off Hand X
settings.desc: Moves the item in your off hand left (negative) or right, in blocks.

settings.name: Off Hand Y
settings.desc: Moves the item in your off hand down (negative) or up, in blocks.

settings.name: Off Hand Z
settings.desc: Moves the item in your off hand closer (positive) or further away, in blocks.

settings.name: Off Hand Tilt
settings.desc: Tips the item in your off hand forward or back, in degrees.

settings.name: Off Hand Turn
settings.desc: Turns the item in your off hand left or right, in degrees.

settings.name: Off Hand Roll
settings.desc: Rolls the item in your off hand sideways, in degrees.

settings.name: Off Hand Size %
settings.desc: How big the item in your off hand is drawn.

settings.name: Swing Speed %
settings.desc: How fast your hand's swing animation plays on your screen. Looks only: attack speed and cooldown don't change.

settings.name: Equip Animation
settings.desc: The dip when you switch items or after an attack. Off: held items stay put.

settings.name: Shield
settings.desc: Hide your shield in first person, or only while you aren't blocking. It still blocks as normal.

name: Light Overlay
desc: Marks spots near you where monsters can spawn, by light level. Toggle with F7.

settings.name: Range
settings.desc: How far around you (in blocks) spots are marked.

settings.name: Style
settings.desc: An X on each spot, a tinted square, or both.

settings.name: Spawn Light
settings.desc: The highest block light monsters spawn at. 0 is right for the Overworld since 1.18.

settings.name: Spawnable Color
settings.desc: Spots where monsters can spawn at any time (dark sky as well as no block light).

settings.name: Night Only Color
settings.desc: Spots under open sky: monsters spawn there only at night or in a storm.

settings.name: Show Safe
settings.desc: Also mark lit spots, where light already stops monsters, in Safe Color.

settings.name: Safe Color
settings.desc: Colour of lit, safe spots with Show Safe on.

name: Menu Blur
desc: Blurs the background behind menus, with its own strength.

settings.name: Strength
settings.desc: How blurry the background gets, on the same scale as the game's Menu Background Blur (which goes to 10).

settings.name: Fade In
settings.desc: Milliseconds the blur takes to fade in when a menu opens. 0 = instant.

settings.name: In Game Menus
settings.desc: Blur the world behind menus opened while playing: pause menu, options, advancements and so on.

settings.name: Title Menus
settings.desc: Blur the panorama behind menus outside a world: world list, server list, options.

name: Motion Blur
desc: Blends frames together for smoother-looking motion. Can cause motion sickness.

settings.name: Strength
settings.desc: How much of the previous frame stays on screen. Higher is blurrier.

settings.name: Only While Moving
settings.desc: Blur only while you turn the camera or move fast, so a still view stays sharp. The blur fades in and out with your speed.

settings.name: Motion Sensitivity
settings.desc: With Only While Moving: how little turning or speed it takes to reach full blur. Higher reacts to smaller movements.

name: Nick Hider
desc: Masks your name and skin on your screen for streaming, and can hide other players' too.

settings.name: Nickname
settings.desc: The name shown instead of yours, up to 16 characters.

settings.name: Own Skin
settings.desc: Your skin on your screen: your real one, a default skin, Steve, Alex, or your own skin.png.

settings.name: Custom Model
settings.desc: Arm width for Own Skin: Custom File. Slim is the thinner Alex-style model.

settings.name: Hide Cape
settings.desc: Hides your cape, and the cape pattern on your elytra, on your screen.

settings.name: Hide Others
settings.desc: Shows other players' names as aliases on your screen, so viewers can't see who you play with.

settings.name: Others Style
settings.desc: Hidden names as Player, Player 3 (in the order you met them) or Player-7F3A (the same each time).

settings.name: Hide Others' Skins
settings.desc: Shows other players with default skins and no capes, on your screen only.

settings.name: Ignore Case
settings.desc: Also catches names typed with other capitals, like notch or NOTCH.

settings.name: Whole Word Only
settings.desc: Only swaps whole names, so Max never turns Maximum into Youimum. Off also swaps inside longer words.

name: NoFog
desc: Clears distance fog. Water, lava, snow, Blindness and Darkness fog stay.

settings.name: Overworld
settings.desc: Clear the fog in the Overworld, and in dimensions added by mods or data packs.

settings.name: Nether
settings.desc: Clear the thick Nether fog.

settings.name: End
settings.desc: Clear the fog in the End.

settings.name: Fog Strength %
settings.desc: How much distance fog is left: 0 removes it, 50 pushes it twice as far away, 100 is vanilla.

settings.name: Nether Fog Strength %
settings.desc: Fog Strength for the Nether only, so you can keep some of its mood. Same (the lowest step) follows Fog Strength.

settings.name: End Fog Strength %
settings.desc: Fog Strength for the End only. Same (the lowest step) follows Fog Strength.

settings.name: Edge Fade %
settings.desc: How softly the world fades out at the edge of your render distance, as a share of vanilla's fade. 0 is a hard edge, 100 is vanilla.

settings.name: Clear Sky Fog
settings.desc: Also remove the haze where the sky meets the horizon, for a crisp horizon line.

name: NoRender
desc: Hides fire, pumpkin blur, screen wobble, totem animation, toasts and other overlays.

settings.name: Fire Overlay
settings.desc: Hide the flames on your screen while you're burning.

settings.name: Fire: Only When Immune
settings.desc: Only hide the flames while fire can't hurt you: Fire Resistance, Creative, or a fire-proof body.

settings.name: Pumpkin Blur
settings.desc: Hide the carved pumpkin view while you wear one.

settings.name: Nausea & Portal
settings.desc: Hide the green nausea and purple portal overlays on your screen.

settings.name: Screen Wobble
settings.desc: Stop the screen warping from Nausea and nether portals.

settings.name: Totem Animation
settings.desc: Hide the big totem that pops up when one saves you.

settings.name: Totem Size %
settings.desc: Size of the totem pop animation while it isn't hidden. 100 is vanilla.

settings.name: Advancement Toasts
settings.desc: Hide the advancement pop-ups in the top-right corner. The chat message stays.

settings.name: Recipe Toasts
settings.desc: Hide the "New Recipes Unlocked!" pop-ups.

settings.name: Tutorial Toasts
settings.desc: Hide the tutorial hints for new players (move, look around, punch a tree).

name: Pack Tweaks
desc: Lower fire and shield, faded overlays, clear glass, still maps and a fishing line colour.

settings.name: Low Fire
settings.desc: Draw the flames on your screen lower, so they cover less of your view.

settings.name: Fire Lowered By
settings.desc: How far the on-fire overlay is moved down, so it covers less of your view.

settings.name: Fire Opacity %
settings.desc: How solid the flames on your screen are. Vanilla draws them at 90.

settings.name: Pumpkin Overlay %
settings.desc: How solid the carved pumpkin view is while you wear one. 0 hides it, 100 is vanilla.

settings.name: Freezing Overlay %
settings.desc: How solid the frost around your screen is in powder snow. 0 hides it, 100 is vanilla.

settings.name: Low Shield
settings.desc: Hold your shield lower in first person, so it covers less of your view.

settings.name: Shield Lowered By
settings.desc: How far Low Shield moves the shield down.

settings.name: Off-Hand Totem Size %
settings.desc: Size of a totem held in your off hand, in first person. 100 is vanilla.

settings.name: Clear Glass
settings.desc: Plain glass loses the white streaks inside its frame, so it looks perfectly clear. Reloads textures.

settings.name: No Map Bobbing
settings.desc: A map in your hand stays still while you walk, so it's easy to read. View Bobbing is kept for everything else.

settings.name: Hide Arrows Stuck In You
settings.desc: Arrows and bee stingers stuck in your own player aren't drawn (in third person and the inventory).

settings.name: Fishing Line Color
settings.desc: Colour of fishing lines. Black is vanilla.

settings.name: Spyglass Overlay %
settings.desc: How solid the dark ring around the spyglass view is. 0 hides it, 100 is vanilla.

name: Particles
desc: Hides particle clutter and restyles your hit particles: more of them, your colour, your size.

settings.name: Hide Crits
settings.desc: Hides the star-shaped particles from critical hits.

settings.name: Hide Sharpness
settings.desc: Hides the blue sparks from hits with Sharpness and other damage enchantments.

settings.name: Hide Damage Hearts
settings.desc: Hides the dark hearts that fly off a mob or player when it takes damage.

settings.name: Hide Sweeps
settings.desc: Hides the white arc of a sword sweep attack.

settings.name: Hide Explosions
settings.desc: Hides explosion clouds and the debris they throw out. The sound and knockback are unchanged.

settings.name: Hide Totem Pops
settings.desc: Hides the green and gold burst when someone uses a Totem of Undying.

settings.name: Hide Fireworks
settings.desc: Hides firework rockets' sparks, trails and bursts.

settings.name: Hide Mining Particles
settings.desc: No little cracks fly off the block you are breaking.

settings.name: Hide Block Break Particles
settings.desc: No burst of block pieces when a block breaks (yours or anyone's). The break sound stays.

settings.name: Potion Swirls
settings.desc: Hide Own: your own effect swirls are skipped while you look through your own eyes. Hide All: nobody's effect swirls are drawn.

settings.name: Crit Multiplier
settings.desc: How many crit bursts each critical hit shows (1 = vanilla). Off while Hide Crits is on.

settings.name: Sharpness Multiplier
settings.desc: How many sharpness bursts each enchanted hit shows (1 = vanilla). Off while Hide Sharpness is on.

settings.name: Only My Hits
settings.desc: Multipliers apply only to hits you just landed, not to other players' fights.

settings.name: Always Crits
settings.desc: Show crit particles on every hit you land, not only on real critical hits. Cosmetic only.

settings.name: Always Sharpness
settings.desc: Show sharpness sparks on every hit you land, even without a damage enchantment. Cosmetic only.

settings.name: Custom Crit Color
settings.desc: Paint crit particles (melee crits and critical arrow trails) in Crit Color.

settings.name: Crit Color
settings.desc: Colour of crit particles while Custom Crit Color is on.

settings.name: Custom Sharpness Color
settings.desc: Paint sharpness sparks in Sharpness Color.

settings.name: Sharpness Color
settings.desc: Colour of sharpness sparks while Custom Sharpness Color is on.

settings.name: Hit Particle Size %
settings.desc: Size of crit and sharpness particles (100 = vanilla).

name: Scoreboard
desc: Hide or recolour the numbers, trim, restyle, move, resize or hide the sidebar.

settings.name: Numbers
settings.desc: The score numbers on the right. Auto hides them when they only count the lines down (15, 14, 13...). Text a server puts there instead always stays.

settings.name: Recolor Numbers
settings.desc: Draw the score numbers in Number Color instead of red. Numbers a server colours itself keep theirs.

settings.name: Number Color
settings.desc: The colour Recolor Numbers uses.

settings.name: Hide Server IP Line
settings.desc: Drop the last line when it is just the server's address (play.example.net).

settings.name: Show Title
settings.desc: Show the sidebar's title above the lines.

settings.name: Max Lines
settings.desc: Show at most this many lines, from the top.

settings.name: Line Height
settings.desc: Space per line in pixels. Vanilla uses 9.

settings.name: Vanilla Look
settings.desc: Vanilla's flat dark strips. Off: Evade's panel, in the chosen Background Style.

settings.name: Text Shadow
settings.desc: Draw the sidebar's text with a shadow.

settings.name: Hide Scoreboard
settings.desc: Don't draw the sidebar at all.

settings.name: Scale
settings.desc: How big the widget is drawn. You can also scroll over it in the HUD editor to resize it.

settings.name: Background
settings.desc: Draws a panel behind the widget so it stays readable on bright scenes.

settings.name: Background Style
settings.desc: Look of the panel: Evade (soft rounded), Solid, Glass (frosted) or Outline (border only).

settings.name: Background Opacity
settings.desc: How see-through the panel is. Lower lets more of the game show through.

settings.name: Hide In Menus
settings.desc: Hides it while a menu or inventory is open. Chat doesn't count.

settings.name: Only In Combat
settings.desc: Shows it only during a fight: for 8 seconds after you hit something or take damage.

settings.name: Smooth Font
settings.desc: Draw this widget's text in Evade's smooth font instead of the pixel font.

name: ShinyPots
desc: Makes potions glint, with optional slot tints and level and time badges.

settings.name: Drinkable
settings.desc: Potions you drink.

settings.name: Splash
settings.desc: Splash potions.

settings.name: Lingering
settings.desc: Lingering potions.

settings.name: Tipped Arrows
settings.desc: Arrows tipped with a potion.

settings.name: Stews & Ominous Bottles
settings.desc: Suspicious stews and ominous bottles too. A stew keeps its effect secret, so it only shines with Effect Type Any and Min Level 1, and never gets a tint or badge.

settings.name: Effect Type
settings.desc: Only items with at least one effect of this kind shine.

settings.name: Min Level
settings.desc: Only items with an effect at this level or higher shine (2 = Strength II and up).

settings.name: Show On
settings.desc: Where the shine shows: everywhere (also on the ground and in item frames), only in inventories and the hotbar, or there and in your own hands.

settings.name: Slot Tint
settings.desc: Colours the slot behind each potion in its potion colour.

settings.name: Tint Style
settings.desc: Fill the slot, outline it, or draw a line under the item.

settings.name: Tint Opacity
settings.desc: How strong the slot tint is, in percent.

settings.name: Tint Hotbar
settings.desc: Tints hotbar slots too, not only inventories.

settings.name: Badge
settings.desc: Small text on potion slots: the level (II and up) in the top corner, the time left in the bottom one.

name: Tab Tweaks
desc: Numeric ping, yourself and friends first, hide NPC entries, player count and size for the player list.

settings.name: Numeric Ping
settings.desc: Show each player's ping in milliseconds, coloured by quality, instead of signal bars.

settings.name: Ping Colours
settings.desc: Colour the ping number by quality: green, yellow, orange, red. Off: plain grey.

settings.name: Yourself First
settings.desc: Moves your own name to the top of the list.

settings.name: Friends First
settings.desc: Moves your Evade friends (and Highlighted Players) to the top, after you.

settings.name: Hide NPC Entries
settings.desc: Hides fake entries servers add for NPCs and decoration: ones without a valid player name or a real account.

settings.name: Player Count
settings.desc: A line above the list with how many players are in it.

settings.name: Scale
settings.desc: Size of the player list.

settings.name: Hide Header
settings.desc: Hide the text the server puts above the player list.

settings.name: Hide Footer
settings.desc: Hide the text the server puts below the player list.

name: TNT Timer
desc: Shows a countdown above primed TNT you can see.

settings.name: Range
settings.desc: How far away (in blocks) TNT gets a timer.

settings.name: Show Below
settings.desc: Only show a timer once this many seconds are left. 0 shows it for the whole fuse.

settings.name: Max Timers
settings.desc: Show at most this many timers, nearest first. 0 is no limit.

settings.name: Minecarts
settings.desc: Also time primed TNT minecarts (an estimate, shown with ~).

settings.name: Format
settings.desc: Count down in seconds, in game ticks (20 per second), as a shrinking bar, or seconds with a bar under them.

settings.name: Decimals
settings.desc: Decimal places for seconds. 0 rounds up to whole seconds.

settings.name: Color Mode
settings.desc: Gradient fades from Safe Color to Danger Color, Threshold switches at Danger At, Static always uses Safe Color.

settings.name: Safe Color
settings.desc: Colour while there is plenty of time left.

settings.name: Danger Color
settings.desc: Colour as the TNT is about to go off.

settings.name: Danger At
settings.desc: Seconds left at which the colour turns fully to Danger Color.

settings.name: Flash Below
settings.desc: Flash white in the last seconds of the fuse. 0 never flashes.

settings.name: Scale
settings.desc: Size of the timer.

settings.name: Distance Scaling
settings.desc: Shrink timers on far-away TNT (down to 40%).

settings.name: Height Offset
settings.desc: How far above the TNT (in blocks) the timer floats.

settings.name: Background
settings.desc: Draw a dark panel behind the timer.

settings.name: Background Opacity
settings.desc: How solid the panel behind the timer is, in percent.

settings.name: Text Shadow
settings.desc: Draw the countdown with a drop shadow.

name: Block Outline
desc: Custom block selection outline.

settings.name: Color
settings.desc: Colour of the outline (and of the fill while Sync Fill With Outline is on).

settings.name: Color Mode
settings.desc: Static uses Color, Chroma cycles the rainbow, Pulse breathes in and out, Break Progress fades from start to end colour as you mine.

settings.name: Chroma Speed
settings.desc: How fast Chroma cycles: 1 is one full cycle every 4 seconds.

settings.name: Pulse Speed
settings.desc: Pulses per second in Pulse mode.

settings.name: Break Start Color
settings.desc: Break Progress colour when you start mining a block.

settings.name: Break End Color
settings.desc: Break Progress colour just before the block breaks.

settings.name: Thickness
settings.desc: Width of the outline.

settings.name: Outline Shape
settings.desc: Exact follows the block's shape (stairs, fences), Bounding Box draws one box around it, Full Block always a whole cube.

settings.name: Fill
settings.desc: Tint the faces of the block too.

settings.name: Fill Color
settings.desc: Colour of the fill when Sync Fill With Outline is off.

settings.name: Sync Fill With Outline
settings.desc: Fill with the outline's colour (including Chroma and Break Progress) instead of Fill Color.

settings.name: Fill Opacity
settings.desc: How strong the fill tint is.

settings.name: Fill Shape
settings.desc: Exact tints each part of the block's shape, Bounding Box fills the outline's box.

settings.name: Fill Animation
settings.desc: While you mine a block, its fill grows with the mining progress.

settings.name: Smooth Movement
settings.desc: Glide the outline from block to block instead of jumping.

settings.name: Movement Speed
settings.desc: How quickly Smooth Movement catches up with the block you look at.

settings.name: Fade With Distance
settings.desc: Fade the outline and fill as the block gets further away, down to 40% at the edge of your reach.

settings.name: Hide In Third Person
settings.desc: Use the vanilla outline while in third person.

name: FOV Changer
desc: Sets your FOV and how speed, sprinting and items change it.

settings.name: Mode
settings.desc: Lock: speed, sprinting and flying never change your FOV. Custom Effects: choose how much they do.

settings.name: Use Game FOV
settings.desc: Keep the FOV from Minecraft's options; turn off to use the FOV below.

settings.name: FOV
settings.desc: The field of view to use when Use Game FOV is off.

settings.name: Speed & Sprint Effect %
settings.desc: Custom Effects: how much sprinting, Speed and Slowness change your FOV (100 = vanilla).

settings.name: Flying Effect
settings.desc: Custom Effects: widen the FOV a little while flying, like vanilla.

settings.name: Keep Bow Zoom
settings.desc: Still zoom in slightly while drawing a bow.

settings.name: Spyglass Zoom
settings.desc: Zoom in while looking through a spyglass.

settings.name: Underwater FOV
settings.desc: Narrow the FOV a little underwater and in lava, like vanilla.

settings.name: Death Zoom
settings.desc: Slowly zoom in when you die, like vanilla.

settings.name: Transition Speed
settings.desc: How fast FOV effects ease in and out (0.5 = vanilla, 1 = instant).

settings.name: Hand FOV
settings.desc: The FOV your hand and held item are drawn with (70 = vanilla). Higher draws them smaller.

settings.name: Hand FOV Ignores Zoom
settings.desc: Keep your hand its normal size while you zoom.

settings.name: Alt FOV Key
settings.desc: Switches to the Alt FOV below.

settings.name: Alt FOV Mode
settings.desc: Hold the key for the Alt FOV, or tap it to switch and tap again to switch back.

settings.name: Alt FOV
settings.desc: The FOV to use while the Alt FOV Key is active.

settings.name: Third Person FOV Offset
settings.desc: Added to your FOV in third person, front and back view.

settings.name: Smooth Switch
settings.desc: Ease between FOVs when the Alt FOV Key or the camera view changes.

name: HUD Toggle
desc: A key that hides only Evade's HUD widgets, and an option to keep them out of screenshots.

settings.name: Toggle Key
settings.desc: Press to hide or show Evade's HUD widgets. The game's own HUD stays; F1 still hides everything.

settings.name: Hide In Screenshots
settings.desc: F2 screenshots are taken without Evade's widgets (the game's own HUD is kept). They vanish for one frame while the shot is taken.

settings.name: Show Toast
settings.desc: A short note when the toggle key hides or shows the HUD.

name: No Hurt Cam
desc: Removes the screen shake when hit.

settings.name: World Shake %
settings.desc: How much the camera still tilts when you're hurt (0 = none, 100 = vanilla).

settings.name: Hand Shake %
settings.desc: How much your hand and held item still shake when you're hurt (0 = none, 100 = vanilla).

settings.name: Death Tilt
settings.desc: Keep the camera's slow sideways tilt when you die.

name: Snaplook
desc: Hold a key to see yourself from the front. Let go to look back.

settings.name: Snaplook Key
settings.desc: Hold this key to look at yourself from the front. Pick a key or a side mouse button.

settings.name: Mode
settings.desc: Hold the key to see yourself, or tap it to switch and tap again to switch back.

settings.name: View
settings.desc: Front: third person looking at your face. Back: third person behind you.

settings.name: End In Menus
settings.desc: Go back to your own view when a menu, chat or inventory opens.

name: Sound Tweaks
desc: Volume sliders for rain, thunder, explosions and other loud sounds.

settings.name: Rain
settings.desc: Volume in %, on top of Minecraft's sliders. Rain and rain dripping off roofs.

settings.name: Thunder
settings.desc: Volume in %, on top of Minecraft's sliders. Thunder and lightning strikes.

settings.name: Explosions
settings.desc: Volume in %, on top of Minecraft's sliders. TNT, creepers, crystals, beds and anchors.

settings.name: Fireworks
settings.desc: Volume in %, on top of Minecraft's sliders. Firework launches, bangs and crackles.

settings.name: Villagers
settings.desc: Volume in %, on top of Minecraft's sliders. Villagers and wandering traders.

settings.name: Anvils
settings.desc: Volume in %, on top of Minecraft's sliders. Using, placing and landing anvils.

settings.name: Armour Equip
settings.desc: Volume in %, on top of Minecraft's sliders. Putting armour and elytra on.

settings.name: Hit Sounds
settings.desc: Volume in %, on top of Minecraft's sliders. Player attack sounds: strong, weak, crit, sweep, knockback.

name: Time Changer
desc: Change the time of day you see. The server's time is untouched.

settings.name: Time
settings.desc: The time of day to show. Custom uses Custom Ticks. Custom Speed starts its day here.

settings.name: Custom Ticks
settings.desc: Time for the Custom preset: 0 is morning, 6000 noon, 12000 dusk, 18000 midnight.

settings.name: Flow
settings.desc: Fixed: hold the preset. Server + Offset: the server's time, shifted. Custom Speed: your own day from the preset at Day Speed. Real Time: your computer's clock (06:00 is sunrise).

settings.name: Offset (ticks)
settings.desc: Server + Offset: how far ahead (or behind) of the server's time to show. 1000 ticks is an hour.

settings.name: Day Speed
settings.desc: Custom Speed: how fast the day runs. 1 is normal, 0 stops it, 20 is a day a minute.

settings.name: Real Time Offset (h)
settings.desc: Real Time: hours to add to your clock, e.g. to show another time zone.

settings.name: Smooth Transition
settings.desc: Ease the sky to the new time when switched on or when the preset or flow changes.

settings.name: Transition Speed
settings.desc: How fast a transition plays. At 1 the longest takes about two seconds.

settings.name: Moon Phase
settings.desc: The moon to show at night. Server keeps the real phase.

settings.name: Bright Stars
settings.desc: Make the night stars up to four times brighter.

name: ToggleSprint
desc: Tap sprint or sneak to toggle them.

settings.name: Sprint Mode
settings.desc: Toggle: tap to start or stop sprinting. Hold: sprint only while the key is held. Always: always sprint when you can.

settings.name: Toggle Key
settings.desc: A separate key that toggles sprint, leaving the game's sprint key as a normal hold. None uses the sprint key itself.

settings.name: Sprint On Join
settings.desc: Whether sprint starts toggled on when you join a world or server. Remember keeps it as you left it.

settings.name: Toggle Sneak
settings.desc: Tap sneak to stay sneaking, tap again to stand. Off while the game's own Sneak: Toggle is on.

settings.name: Sneak On Join
settings.desc: Whether a toggled sneak starts on when you join a world or server. Remember keeps it as you left it.

settings.name: Release Sneak When Mounting
settings.desc: Stand up when you get on a horse, boat or minecart, so a toggled sneak doesn't get you straight off again.

settings.name: Release Sneak When Flying
settings.desc: Stand up when you start flying or gliding, so you don't keep sinking. Tap sneak again to toggle it back.

settings.name: Release Sneak In Water
settings.desc: Stand up when you go into water, so you don't keep sinking. Tap sneak again to toggle it back.

settings.name: Pause In Menus
settings.desc: Let go of a toggled sprint and sneak while a menu or chat is open; they come back when it closes.

settings.name: Show Status
settings.desc: Shows a line of text on screen saying whether you're sprinting or sneaking, and why.

settings.name: Sprint Toggled Text
settings.desc: What the status line says while sprint is toggled on. Leave blank to hide that line.

settings.name: Sprint Held Text
settings.desc: What the status line says while you hold the sprint key. Leave blank to hide that line.

settings.name: Sprint Vanilla Text
settings.desc: What the status line says while you sprint the normal way (double-tap forward). Leave blank to hide that line.

settings.name: Sneak Toggled Text
settings.desc: What the status line says while sneak is toggled on. Leave blank to hide that line.

settings.name: Sneak Held Text
settings.desc: What the status line says while you hold the sneak key. Leave blank to hide that line.

settings.name: Show When Idle
settings.desc: Show a line even when you're neither sprinting nor sneaking.

settings.name: Idle Text
settings.desc: What the status line says while you're neither sprinting nor sneaking, with Show When Idle on.

settings.name: Text Color
settings.desc: Colour of the widget's text.

settings.name: Brackets
settings.desc: Wraps each line in square brackets, like [120 FPS].

settings.name: Text Shadow
settings.desc: Draws a dark drop shadow under the text so it reads on any background.

settings.name: Chroma
settings.desc: Cycles the text through rainbow colours instead of using Text Color.

settings.name: Text Align
settings.desc: Auto lines text up with the screen edge the widget is anchored to, so changing numbers don't jitter.

settings.name: Label/Value Colors
settings.desc: In lines like "Ping: 42 ms", draw the label in Text Color and the value in Value Color.

settings.name: Value Color
settings.desc: Colour of the value after the label, with Label/Value Colors on.

settings.name: Scale
settings.desc: How big the widget is drawn. You can also scroll over it in the HUD editor to resize it.

settings.name: Background
settings.desc: Draws a panel behind the widget so it stays readable on bright scenes.

settings.name: Background Style
settings.desc: Look of the panel: Evade (soft rounded), Solid, Glass (frosted) or Outline (border only).

settings.name: Background Opacity
settings.desc: How see-through the panel is. Lower lets more of the game show through.

settings.name: Hide In Menus
settings.desc: Hides it while a menu or inventory is open. Chat doesn't count.

settings.name: Only In Combat
settings.desc: Shows it only during a fight: for 8 seconds after you hit something or take damage.

settings.name: Smooth Font
settings.desc: Draw this widget's text in Evade's smooth font instead of the pixel font.

name: Weather Changer
desc: Change the weather you see. The server's weather is untouched.

settings.name: Weather
settings.desc: The weather you see. Server shows the real weather (Precipitation and Rain Volume still apply).

settings.name: Precipitation
settings.desc: Rain or snow: as each biome has it, or the same everywhere. Deserts and other dry biomes stay dry.

settings.name: Rain Intensity %
settings.desc: How heavy forced rain or snow is, and how much it darkens the sky.

settings.name: Thunder Darkness %
settings.desc: How dark a forced thunderstorm makes the sky. Lighter rain makes it lighter too, as in vanilla.

settings.name: Smooth Transition
settings.desc: Fade between weathers, and back to the real weather when turned off, instead of switching at once.

settings.name: Transition Seconds
settings.desc: How long a full change of weather takes.

settings.name: Lightning Flashes
settings.desc: Fake: distant flashes and thunder in the Thunder modes, even when the server has no storm. Hide Lightning Flashes in the game's accessibility options still hides the flashes.

settings.name: Rain Volume %
settings.desc: How loud rain sounds are. 0 mutes them.

name: AutoGG
desc: Says gg when a match ends.

settings.name: Message
settings.desc: What to say. Custom picks from Custom Text.

settings.name: Custom Text
settings.desc: Your own messages for Message: Custom, split with | (e.g. gg|gg wp). Plain chat only: commands are never sent.

settings.name: Randomize
settings.desc: Pick a random Custom Text message each game (never the same twice in a row); off goes through them in order.

settings.name: Trigger Source
settings.desc: System Only answers just the server's own announcements. System + Chat also reads player chat, so anyone typing a match line can set it off.

settings.name: Server Preset
settings.desc: Which lines end a game. Auto uses Hypixel's on Hypixel and the generic ones elsewhere. Custom uses Custom Trigger.

settings.name: Custom Trigger
settings.desc: For Server Preset: Custom, a regular expression for your server's end-of-game line (case doesn't matter; start it with ^ to match only the start).

settings.name: Delay (s)
settings.desc: How long to wait after the game ends (or starts) before saying it.

settings.name: Cooldown (s)
settings.desc: The least time between two gg messages, so one game never gets two.

settings.name: Channel
settings.desc: Where to say it: your current chat, all chat (/ac) or party chat (/pc).

settings.name: Good Luck Message
settings.desc: Also say GL Text when the server announces that a game is starting.

settings.name: GL Text
settings.desc: What to say at the start of a game. Plain chat only.

name: AutoReconnect
desc: Rejoins the server after you get disconnected.

settings.name: Delay (s)
settings.desc: How long to wait before the first reconnect.

settings.name: Max Attempts
settings.desc: Reconnects in a row before giving up (0: never give up).

settings.name: Back-off
settings.desc: Wait twice as long before each new attempt, up to Max Delay.

settings.name: Max Delay (s)
settings.desc: The longest Back-off waits between attempts (never shorter than Delay).

settings.name: Ignore Words
settings.desc: Don't reconnect when the kick message contains one of these, split with | (case doesn't matter). Bans, whitelist refusals and AFK kicks are always skipped.

settings.name: Show Buttons
settings.desc: Cancel and Reconnect Now buttons on the disconnect screen.

settings.name: Countdown Color
settings.desc: Colour of the reconnect countdown on the disconnect screen.

settings.name: Countdown Style
settings.desc: How the countdown shows on the disconnect screen. Hidden still reconnects.

settings.name: Title Button
settings.desc: A Rejoin button on the title screen for the last server you played on.

name: AutoTip
desc: Tips everyone on a timer with /tip all. Hypixel only.

settings.name: Every (min)
settings.desc: How often to tip while you stay on the server.

settings.name: Server Filter
settings.desc: Only tip on servers whose address contains one of these, split with | (case doesn't matter).

settings.name: Tip On Join
settings.desc: Tip once Join Delay after you join, instead of waiting a whole interval first.

settings.name: Join Delay (s)
settings.desc: How long after joining the first tip waits, with Tip On Join on.

settings.name: Hide Responses
settings.desc: Keep the server's replies to the tip out of chat.

settings.name: Summary
settings.desc: One short note per tip: a toast, or a chat line in place of the hidden replies.

settings.name: Show Count
settings.desc: Number the summary with how many tips you've sent this session (Tip #3).

name: Quick Play
desc: A picker for Hypixel games and modes: one click sends the /play or /lobby command.

settings.name: Open Key
settings.desc: Opens the Quick Play picker in game. Unbound by default.

settings.name: Close On Pick
settings.desc: Close the picker after you click a mode. Off keeps it open (one command per click either way).

settings.name: Show Recent
settings.desc: Show the modes you played last as a row at the top of the picker.

name: Text Hotkeys
desc: One-click macros: keys that send a chat message or command you typed, once per press.

settings.name: Cooldown (s)
settings.desc: The shortest time between two hotkey messages (0.05 to 3 seconds). Kick Guard below still stops a burst that the game's own spam filter would kick you for.

settings.name: Kick Guard
settings.desc: Holds back a press that would trip Minecraft's built-in spam kick (about 10 quick messages, then about 1 a second). Turn off only if the server allows more.

settings.name: Confirmation
settings.desc: A small notification with what was sent (and the hotkey's label), or why a press was skipped.

settings.name: Add To Chat History
settings.desc: Put sent messages in your chat history, so the up arrow in chat brings them back.

name: BetterChat
desc: Chat timestamps, stacked repeats, longer history, copy, mention highlights and a filter.

settings.name: Timestamps
settings.desc: Shows the time each message arrived in front of it.

settings.name: Time Format
settings.desc: 24-hour or 12-hour clock, with or without seconds.

settings.name: Time Brackets
settings.desc: What goes around the timestamp.

settings.name: Time Color
settings.desc: Colour of the timestamp (and of the copy button).

settings.name: Copy Button
settings.desc: Click a message's timestamp (or the ⧉ after it without timestamps) to copy the message.

settings.name: Stack Repeats
settings.desc: A repeated message is shown once with a (x3) counter instead of filling chat.

settings.name: Stack Mode
settings.desc: Consecutive: only a repeat of the newest line stacks. Recent Lines: a repeat of any of the last few lines moves down to the bottom and stacks.

settings.name: Look-back Lines
settings.desc: How many of the newest messages Recent Lines checks for a repeat.

settings.name: Counter Color
settings.desc: Colour of the (x3) counter.

settings.name: History Lines
settings.desc: How many chat lines you can scroll back through. Vanilla keeps 100.

settings.name: Keep Chat On Server Switch
settings.desc: Keeps chat when a network moves you to another of its servers, instead of clearing it.

settings.name: Keep On Disconnect
settings.desc: Keeps chat (and your sent-message history) when you leave a server or world, with a line marking where you left.

settings.name: Highlight Mentions
settings.desc: Colours your name in other players' chat, and your keywords in any line, with a bar beside it.

settings.name: Mention Keywords
settings.desc: Extra words that count as a mention, besides your name. Whole words, any case.

settings.name: Highlight Color
settings.desc: Colour of a mention and of the bar beside its line.

settings.name: Mention Sound
settings.desc: Plays a ping when you are mentioned (at most once a second).

settings.name: Mention Volume
settings.desc: How loud the mention ping is.

settings.name: Filter
settings.desc: Hides or collapses chat lines that contain one of your Filter Words.

settings.name: Filter Words
settings.desc: Text to filter, separated by |. Matches anywhere in a line, ignoring case. Start an entry with re: for a regular expression.

settings.name: Filter Action
settings.desc: Hide drops the line. Collapse shows [filtered] instead; hover it to read the line.

settings.name: Hypixel Clean-up
settings.desc: On Hypixel only: hides lobby join announcements, Mystery Box and Soul Well finds, Watchdog reports and store adverts.

settings.name: Coords Guard
settings.desc: Holds back a chat message that contains your current X and Z (within 3 blocks) once, with a warning. Send it again to send it anyway. Off in singleplayer and near spawn.

name: Chat Heads
desc: The sender's face in front of their chat messages.

settings.name: Size
settings.desc: How big the faces are, in pixels. Chat lines are 9 high.

settings.name: Only Players
settings.desc: Only lines from a player are moved over for a face. Off: every line is, so chat stays lined up.

name: Chat Tabs
desc: Tabs above chat for party, guild, private and friend messages, plus your own rules.

settings.name: Party Tab
settings.desc: A tab for Hypixel party chat and Evade party messages, and the sound a new line in it plays.

settings.name: Guild Tab
settings.desc: A tab for Hypixel guild and officer chat, and the sound a new line in it plays.

settings.name: DMs Tab
settings.desc: A tab for Hypixel private messages (From and To lines), and the sound a new one plays.

settings.name: Hypixel Tabs Only On Hypixel
settings.desc: Show the Party, Guild and DMs tabs only while you're on Hypixel.

settings.name: Evade Friends Tab
settings.desc: A tab for messages from your Evade friends and party, and the sound a new one plays.

settings.name: Unread Badges
settings.desc: Show how many new lines a tab has that you haven't looked at.

settings.name: Sound Volume
settings.desc: How loud the tab sounds are (at most one a second per tab).

settings.name: Back To All On Close
settings.desc: Closing chat switches back to All, so no new line is hidden from you while you play.

name: Discord Status
desc: Shows what you're playing on your Discord profile.

settings.name: Hide Server Address
settings.desc: Show "Playing multiplayer" instead of the server's address, so friends don't see where you play.

settings.name: Use Server List Name
settings.desc: Show the name you gave the server in your server list instead of its address.

settings.name: Show Elapsed Time
settings.desc: Show how long you've been playing under your status.

settings.name: Elapsed Since
settings.desc: Count the time from when you joined the current world or server, or from when the game started.

settings.name: Show In Menus
settings.desc: Keep a status ("In menus") while you're on the title screen. Off: no status outside a world.

settings.name: Show Discord Button
settings.desc: Add a "Join the Discord" button to your status so friends can find the Evade Discord.

name: Emoji
desc: Type :skull: in chat for a skull emoji, or pick emoji from a grid. Plain Unicode everyone sees.

settings.name: Convert Shortcodes
settings.desc: Turn :skull:, :fire:, :heart: and other codes into their emoji as you type them and when you send.

settings.name: Picker Button
settings.desc: A smiley button at the end of the chat box that opens a grid of emoji to click.

name: Evade Icons
desc: Shows an Evade icon in the tab list next to players using Evade.

settings.name: Show Icons
settings.desc: Shows an Evade logo in the tab list next to other players who are using Evade right now.

settings.name: Show That I Use Evade
settings.desc: Lets other Evade players see the icon next to your name. Off stops sharing it.

name: Friends
desc: Friends and parties: see who's online and where, invite friends to a party and share pings.

settings.name: Online Toasts
settings.desc: A toast when a friend comes online or goes offline.

settings.name: Request Toasts
settings.desc: Toasts for friend requests, party invites and people joining or leaving your party.

settings.name: Join Prompts
settings.desc: When a friend starts playing on a server they share, a [Join] button in chat. You always confirm before joining.

settings.name: Message Toasts
settings.desc: A toast when a friend or your party sends you a message.

settings.name: Messages In Chat
settings.desc: Also show friend and party messages in your chat, marked [Evade]. Click one to reply. Only you see them.

settings.name: Friend Colours
settings.desc: Shows your friends' names in their own colour in chat and the tab list. Only on your screen.

settings.name: Friend Colour
settings.desc: The colour of friends' names.

settings.name: Highlighted Players
settings.desc: Other players whose names also get the friend colour (they don't need Evade). Kept on this PC only.

settings.name: Share Activity
settings.desc: Friends and your party see whether you're in menus, in singleplayer, on a server or AFK, and for how long. Only while you're online.

name: Hypixel Stats
desc: Shows Hypixel stats (BedWars star, SkyWars level, network level) next to names in the tab list (and optionally in chat). Needs your own Hypixel API key from developer.hypixel.net.

settings.name: Stat
settings.desc: What to show after each name. Auto picks the stat of the game you're in (from the scoreboard), else network level.

settings.name: Show Yourself
settings.desc: Also show your own stat in the tab list.

settings.name: Show In Chat
settings.desc: Also puts the stat in front of chat messages from players in the tab list (only ones already looked up).

name: Notifier
desc: Alerts about your own player: totem pops, low health, hunger or air, your death spot and a full inventory.

settings.name: Totem Pops
settings.desc: Alerts you each time your own totem pops, with how many you have popped since you last died.

settings.name: Low Health
settings.desc: Alerts you once when your health drops to Health Threshold.

settings.name: Health Threshold
settings.desc: In health points: 2 is one heart, so 6 is three hearts.

settings.name: Low Hunger
settings.desc: Alerts you once when your food bar drops to Hunger Threshold.

settings.name: Hunger Threshold
settings.desc: In food points: 2 is one drumstick. At 6 or less you can no longer sprint.

settings.name: Low Air
settings.desc: Alerts you under water once 30% of your air is left.

settings.name: Death Coords
settings.desc: Says in chat where you died; click the coordinates to copy them. Not on servers that hide coordinates.

settings.name: Inventory Full
settings.desc: Alerts you once when your inventory has no free slot left.

settings.name: Output
settings.desc: Where alerts show: a chat line, a toast at the side of the screen, both, or a title in the middle.

settings.name: Sound
settings.desc: A sound with each alert.

settings.name: Accent Color
settings.desc: Colour of an alert's title, and of the coordinates in the death message.

name: Pack Organizer
desc: Star resource packs to keep them at the top of the list.

settings.name: Favourites First
settings.desc: Put starred packs at the top of the Available list.

settings.name: Favourites Only
settings.desc: Show only starred packs in the Available list. The ★ button next to the search box switches this.

settings.name: Pack Feature Check
settings.desc: Tells you when a pack you turn on uses connected textures, custom items, entity models or skies that no installed mod reads, and warns about packs that make stone see-through. The ? button in the pack screen lists every pack.

name: Party Ping
desc: Ping where you look for your party: a marker, toast and minimap dot on the same server.

settings.name: Ping Key
settings.desc: Pings where you look. Hold Sneak for a danger ping. Only while you're in a party.

settings.name: Keep Pick Block In Creative
settings.desc: In creative, looking at a block within reach, the key picks the block as usual instead of pinging.

settings.name: Beams
settings.desc: A beam of light above each ping, so it's easy to spot from far away.

settings.name: Ping Sound
settings.desc: A short sound when a party member pings.

settings.name: Ping Toasts
settings.desc: A toast saying who pinged and where.

settings.name: Show On Minimap
settings.desc: Pings as dots on the Minimap (when it's on).

settings.name: Show My Pings
settings.desc: Your own pings show for you too, the way your party sees them.

settings.name: Label Scale
settings.desc: Size of the text label above each ping.

name: Protection
desc: Warns you before your armour, elytra or held items break.

settings.name: Threshold Mode
settings.desc: Warn at a share of an item's durability, or at a number of uses left.

settings.name: Warn At %
settings.desc: Percent mode: warn once an item is down to this much of its durability.

settings.name: Warn At Uses
settings.desc: Uses Left mode: warn once an item has this many uses left (an elytra, seconds of flight).

settings.name: Elytra Warn At %
settings.desc: Percent mode only: when to warn about an elytra, which wears down by itself as you fly. Uses Left mode warns about it at Warn At Uses like everything else.

settings.name: Critical Warning
settings.desc: A second warning, as a title with a lower sound, just before the item breaks.

settings.name: Critical At %
settings.desc: Percent mode: when the critical warning comes (always below the first one). Uses Left mode gives it at a fifth of Warn At Uses.

settings.name: Armor
settings.desc: Watch your helmet, chestplate or elytra, leggings and boots.

settings.name: Held Item
settings.desc: Watch the item in your main hand.

settings.name: Offhand
settings.desc: Watch the item in your off hand, such as a shield.

settings.name: Only Enchanted
settings.desc: Only warn about enchanted items, the ones worth repairing.

settings.name: Alert
settings.desc: Where the first warning shows: a chat line, a toast, both, or a title. The critical warning is always a title.

settings.name: Sound
settings.desc: A sound with each warning (lower for the critical one).

settings.name: Volume
settings.desc: How loud the warning sound is.

name: Screenshot Tools
desc: Copy, folder and delete buttons on the screenshot message.

settings.name: Copy Button
settings.desc: A [Copy] button that puts the image on your clipboard, ready to paste.

settings.name: Folder Button
settings.desc: A [Folder] button that opens the screenshots folder with the file selected.

settings.name: Delete Button
settings.desc: A [Delete] button. Click it twice to delete the screenshot.

settings.name: Auto Copy
settings.desc: Copies every new screenshot to the clipboard as soon as it is saved.

name: Smooth Chat
desc: New chat lines slide in, chat can stay open after sending, and chat backgrounds fade.

settings.name: Slide In
settings.desc: New lines slide up into place instead of appearing at once.

settings.name: Slide Time
settings.desc: How long the slide takes, in milliseconds.

settings.name: Keep Open After Sending
settings.desc: Pressing Enter sends your message and leaves the chat box open for the next one. Enter on an empty box closes it.

settings.name: Background Opacity %
settings.desc: How dark the background behind chat lines is. 0 hides it.

settings.name: Input Opacity %
settings.desc: How dark the box you type in is. 0 hides it.

name: Streamer Mode
desc: Hides your coordinates, server address and friends' servers from Evade's HUD and turns on Nick Hider.

settings.name: Hide Coordinates
settings.desc: Evade's Coordinates widget, waypoint labels and shares leave out your coordinates.

settings.name: Hide Server Address
settings.desc: The Server widget shows the server's name from your list instead of its address.

settings.name: Turn On Nick Hider
settings.desc: Switch Nick Hider on with Streamer Mode (and off again after, if it was off before).

settings.name: Hide Friend Servers
settings.desc: Friends' servers and message previews are hidden in Evade's friends list and toasts.

settings.name: Indicator
settings.desc: A small Streamer tag in the top-right corner while this is on.

name: Title Screen
desc: An Evade main menu with quick rejoin and your recent servers. Off: the vanilla title screen.

settings.name: Last Server Button
settings.desc: A button that joins the last server you played on again, in one click.

settings.name: Background
settings.desc: Behind the menu: the game's panorama, Evade's animated or plain backdrop, one colour, or your own picture.

settings.name: Background Color
settings.desc: The colour of Background: Solid Color.

settings.name: Blur Panorama
settings.desc: Softens the panorama with the game's menu blur (its strength is Menu Background Blur in Accessibility).

settings.name: Side Panels
settings.desc: Cards beside the buttons on wide screens: your account, servers to continue on and what's new in Evade.

settings.name: Server Status
settings.desc: Pings the servers in Continue playing for players online and ping, like the server list does.

settings.name: Show Version
settings.desc: Minecraft and Evade versions in the bottom corner.

settings.name: Drifting Embers
settings.desc: Soft red embers drifting slowly up over the background.

settings.name: Parallax
settings.desc: The panorama and embers shift gently with your mouse, for a sense of depth.

settings.name: Wardrobe Preview
settings.desc: On wide screens, a small turning preview of you in your equipped cosmetics, with a Wardrobe button.

settings.name: Friends Online
settings.desc: Shows which of your Evade friends are online on the account card (when Friends is on).

settings.name: Menu Effects
settings.desc: Light draws fewer layers, embers and a still preview for weaker graphics. Auto picks Light on built-in graphics.

settings.name: Reduce Motion
settings.desc: A still menu: no intro, no moving background, embers or parallax, and no turning preview.

name: Voice Chat
desc: Opens Simple Voice Chat and shows if this server supports it.
